title.value: GitHub Repositories with Links to Academic Papers: Public Access, Traceability, and Evolution
title.justification: The title clearly describes the paper's focus on GitHub repositories and their links to academic papers.
title.quote: GitHub Repositories with Links to Academic Papers: Public Access, Traceability, and Evolution

extractions.description: The paper investigates the role of academic paper references contained in GitHub repositories. It conducts a large-scale study of 20 thousand GitHub repositories that make references to academic papers and identifies public access, traceability and evolutionary aspects of the links.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving the scientific process through better traceability and access to research papers and code, but it does not directly address any specific Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development goal.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In our context, it also extends to using the resulting network between academic papers and software to advance scientific progress and to support knowledge transfer.
